newsitem.title: LEBANON: Saudi fund lends Lebanon 18 mln riyals.
newsitem.headline: Saudi fund lends Lebanon 18 mln riyals.

text.p: The Saudi Development Fund on Tuesday signed an agreement with the Lebanese government to lend it 18 million Saudi riyals ($4.8 million) to help finance the rebuilding of public schools.

The Lebanese government's reconstruction agency, the Council for Development and Reconstruction (CDR), said in a statement the loan agreement was signed in Beirut by the Saudi fund's vice chairman Mohammad al-Suqair and CDR head Nabil aj-Jisr.
The money will help finance the reconstruction of nine war-damaged schools and the rehabilitation of seven agricultural schools in various Lebanese regions, the statement added.
It is the ninth loan agreement signed between the fund and the Lebanese government and brings to 465 million riyals the total lent by the fund to Beirut.
The latest loan, which covers 25 years including a five-year grace period, bears annual interest of two percent.
